displayOrder.name: Focused full-page editor
displayOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. This is a Korean-language mobile financial recording app called Sobrita. Design ONLY one focused app screen, extending its EXISTING visual design rather than redesigning the brand. Reference image 1 is its real entry screen; reference 2 is its real ledger screen; reference 3 is its Korean UI style reference (ignore its multi-screen board, bezels and historical dates); reference 4 is its existing dark navy pixel cat sprite sheet with golden eyes, cream paws and a teal collar, use only one tiny coherent cat if requested, never the whole sprite strip. References are visual/style grounding, not edit targets.
Target dimensions: one flat mobile app viewport, logical 390 x 844, output at high resolution with the same natural portrait aspect ratio. App content ONLY, edge to edge, no phone body, bezel, rounded device mask, notch, status bar, clock, battery, home indicator, presentation board, title outside the app, or multiple screens.
Style: warm cream paper #F6EFE0 with off-white #FFFDF7 fields, dark navy #202848 lettering and crisp square-corner 2px borders, teal #0E7A72 main buttons with white text, pale teal #D8EDEA selection, muted text #545E7E. Destructive actions use legible rust-red #A63A25. Retain the playful precise pixel typography of PixelifySans for Latin/numbers, readable Galmuri-like Korean pixel type; at most 2 font faces, body 14-16 logical px. NOT a modern rounded white/blue fintech app. No gradients, glass, glossy rendering, blurry pixels, unnecessary drop shadows. Square input borders are part of the existing product. Avoid cards inside cards, section-card overuse, tiny illegible copy, invented metrics or extra features. Use intentional spacing and aligned fields, roughly 20px horizontal margins, minimum 44px touch targets. Keep one dominant primary save action. All functional labels are Korean, spelling must be exact. Currency for the Korean preview is KRW, using ₩ and no decimals.
Today's date anchor is October 29, 2026 in America/Mexico_City. Any October calendar must be mathematically correct; October 1 is Thursday. Only past/present dates are selectable. Preserve all hard constraints. Do not include any concept name or option number in the image. This task is an image proposal only.
Direction name (internal only): Focused full-page editor.
Primary request: A polished full-page EXPENSE editing form with all editable fields visible and a fixed bottom save action. Compact header at top: back arrow, exact title "지출 수정", small "취소" at right. No bottom app navigation while editing.
Content flow:
Label "금액", large bordered amount input "₩5,500" with readable bold pixel digits.
Label "날짜", generously sized square bordered clickable row with calendar icon, "2026년 10월 28일", and right chevron. Make date visibly editable, not tiny metadata.
Label "카테고리", selector row with small existing-style rust-colored food/bowl icon, "식비", downward chevron.
Label "결제 수단", two equal square segment buttons "현금" and "카드"; "카드" selected pale teal with teal border.
Label "메모", off-white bordered input holding "카페 라테".
Below the memo, a restrained friendly helper on the base surface, with ONE small navy pixel cat from the reference about 40px tall and exact two-line copy "기록을 고치면" / "합계도 함께 바뀌어요."
At bottom, a full-width 52px teal primary button "변경사항 저장". Beneath it, a clearly separated quiet red text action with small trash icon "이 지출 삭제". Use sufficient vertical gap to prevent accidental deletion. Bottom padding about 22px. The whole form fits naturally at 390x844 with breathable spacing, crisp typography, no clipped labels, no repeated amounts, no extra illustrated scenes.

Direction name (internal only): Ledger-context quick-edit sheet.
Primary request: Show a compact INCOME edit bottom sheet on top of the existing ledger so the user understands they can edit without leaving transaction history. A single app screen in one viewport, not multiple mockups.
Upper 180 logical px of screen: ledger background with title "거래 내역", month "2026년 10월", tabs "지출" and "수입", income selected, and one visible salary row "급여" with "+₩2,800,000"; this background is dimmed under a soft navy scrim. Do not include a decorative cat in this direction.
A tall off-white square-corner bottom sheet begins around y=190 and fills the rest of the viewport. Subtle short rectangular drag handle centered. Header "수입 수정", close X in upper right.
Edit sheet layout uses compact labeled rows and flat surfaces rather than many tall cards:
"금액" above a large editable bordered field "₩2,800,000" in dark teal.
"날짜" above a bordered tappable calendar row reading "2026년 10월 26일" and right chevron.
"수입 종류" above square chips "급여" (selected pale teal), "부수입", "기타".
"메모" above a square bordered field "10월 급여".
Then a muted helper sentence on the base surface "저장하면 수입 합계에 반영돼요."
A full-width teal primary button "변경사항 저장" anchored near the sheet's bottom. Clearly separated underneath is small red trash icon and text "이 수입 삭제". Keep 20px side padding within the sheet, touchable controls, minimum 14px body copy, generous whitespace, no bank-account field, no savings or invented stats, no bottom navigation under the sheet. Must be a production-plausible bottom sheet, square-edged in the app's pixel style.

Direction name (internal only): Calendar-first correction.
Primary request: A focused expense edit screen with an INLINE EXPANDED CALENDAR, making it obvious how to move a saved expense to another month. Same exact Sobrita brand and coherent screen dimensions as references. Single flat app viewport only.
Header: back arrow, "지출 수정", quiet "취소" on right.
Near top an elegant compact amount area: small label "금액" above a bordered editable field "₩5,500". Under it two compact side-by-side editable selectors, small labels "카테고리" and "결제 수단", values food icon "식비" and "카드" with down chevrons. Preserve readable 14px labels and meaningful whitespace.
Main middle region: label "날짜" and strong selected date "2026년 9월 30일". Then an open calendar directly on the base paper surface, not a raised nested card. Month header centered "2026년 9월" with left and right chevrons. Seven columns with weekday labels EXACTLY "월 화 수 목 금 토 일". September 2026 starts Tuesday. Render this exact grid, blank cells are truly empty:
row 1: blank, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
row 2: 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13
row 3: 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20
row 4: 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27
row 5: 28, 29, 30, blank, blank, blank, blank
The 30 is selected in a square teal tile with white digits. Five spacious calendar rows of equal height. Under calendar a small plain muted explanatory line "10월 28일 → 9월 30일" followed by pale teal inline helper text "9월 지출로 옮겨져요." Do not invent savings totals or account balances.
Below, a compact "메모" input with "카페 라테".
Anchored footer: full-width teal "변경사항 저장" primary button, then comfortably separated rust-red trash icon and "이 지출 삭제" action on the base surface. No app bottom navigation, no cat, no status bar, no extra panels. Fit all elements cleanly at 390 x 844 logical pixels with roughly 20px side padding. More hierarchy and whitespace than decoration.
